account.email_change_body: We will send a link to the new address. Your email changes when you open it.
account.email_change_sent: Check {email} for a link. Your email changes when you open it.

profile.head: Profile
profile.personal_description: Your name, as applications you sign in to see it.
profile.email_hint: Your email is your sign-in. To change it, contact the administrator of your organization.

security.head: Security
security.title: Security
security.subtitle: Your password, two-step verification, and the devices you are signed in on.
security.password_description: Changing it signs you out on every other device, and from every connected app.
security.password_changed: Your password has been changed. Other devices have been signed out.
security.sessions_description: Sign out of any device you don’t recognise, then change your password.
security.no_other_sessions: You’re not signed in anywhere else.
security.two_step_description: Ask for a second proof that it’s you at every sign-in: a code from an app on your phone, or a passkey.
security.authenticator_description: Google Authenticator, 1Password, Authy or any app that shows six-digit codes.
security.authenticator_scan: Scan this QR code with the app, or type the key into it. Then enter the code it shows.
security.passkeys_description: Use your fingerprint, face or screen lock instead of a code.
security.recovery_description: If you lose your phone and your passkeys, each of these signs you in once.
security.recovery_save: Save these codes somewhere safe. They are shown only once, and any earlier ones no longer work.

apps.head: Connected apps
apps.title: Connected apps
apps.subtitle: Applications that can keep you signed in and act for you while you are away.
apps.empty_body: No application is keeping you signed in right now. Applications appear here when you allow them to stay signed in.
apps.scope_offline: Stay signed in when you are away
apps.disconnected_body: It can no longer act for you. You’ll be asked to sign in the next time you use it.
